caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall-mounted piece of furniture with a pointed, arch-shaped top and overall symmetrical design. The main feature is a rectangular mirror with slightly rounded top corners set in the center of the upper section. The wood is a rich, dark brown color with visible grain and subtle carved details. On each side of the mirror, there are vertical, slightly bulbous rectangular structures with horizontal grooved accents, each ending in a small spherical element. Below the mirror, a flat shelf extends outward, supported underneath by a wooden drawer featuring a central round knob. The drawer is decorated with symmetrical cutout and carved patterns along the bottom edge, with a central pointed detail and a horizontal bar connecting the lower ends of the structure. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the artwork.
title: Comb Box
